description: Canonical W2Document field coverage classification: extraction implemented + benchmarked, implemented but weakly benchmarked, schema-supported but not implemented, or annotation unavailable for the external Symage benchmark.

categories.implemented_and_benchmarked: Real production extraction logic exists and the external Symage 600-document benchmark scores real, non-trivial accuracy for it (ground truth has both populated and/or null examples).
categories.implemented_but_weakly_benchmarked: Real production extraction logic exists (a genuine detector/parser path), but the external benchmark's ground truth has zero positive examples to validate accuracy against -- correctness on this field is unverified by this benchmark.
categories.schema_supported_extraction_ready_annota: Canonical schema field exists and production extraction logic already exists (built for the internal synthetic PDF generator's format and/or already zone-calibrated for the external OCR format), but the external Symage dataset's real annotations never populate it, so it cannot be benchmarked here at all.
categories.internal_bookkeeping_not_scored: Not W-2 business content; intentionally excluded from evaluation scoring and CSV downstream output.

notes.box_13_statutory_employee_and_third_part: Zone-calibrated OCR checkbox-mark detection already exists (`_apply_ocr_box_13_layout_fallbacks`, boxes adjacent to retirement_plan's own checkbox), and both flags default False like retirement_plan does -- but the 150 base Symage documents have zero ground-truth-positive (checked) examples for either flag (verified directly: 0/150 True for both in the regenerated ground truth), so correctness cannot be benchmarked here regardless of whether the detector works, the same limitation already documented before Phase 8C.10 for this pair.
notes.employee_suffix_and_address_line_2: The synthetic-generator's own reference implementation (`w2_pipeline.evaluation.synthetic`) hardcodes `suffix=None` always; the external Symage annotations never populate a Box e suffix field or a second address line for either party (confirmed: 0/150 and 0/150 in the annotation-coverage audit) -- not a parser gap, an annotation-source limitation.
notes.box_7_8_10_11_and_box_9: The synthetic-generator's reference implementation documents these as legitimately optional (see `validation/rules.py`'s module docstring); the external Symage annotations never populate any of them for this dataset's identities.
notes.box_14_and_tipped_occupation_codes: `_parse_box_14` exists for the internal synthetic PDF generator's literal-label format; external Symage's Box 14a/14b questions exist on every document but their linked answers are always blank (confirmed: 0/150 populated) -- no OCR fallback was built for this phase per the brief's explicit condition ('only if the source annotations clearly distinguish true Box 14 values from neighboring artifacts'), since there is no populated real example to build or verify one against.
notes.state_local_18_19_20: The zone-based OCR fallback (`_apply_ocr_state_local_layout_fallback`) already covers boxes 18-20 by the same mechanism as 15-17 (calibrated from the same real document), ready for a real document that populates them -- this dataset's annotations never do (confirmed: 0/150), so they remain unverified rather than unimplemented.
